about:
Pine Electronics, Inc. operates from Grove City, Pennsylvania, at the intersection of Interstates 79 and 80. The company serves as an electronics and electromechanical assembly contract manufacturer for industrial equipment OEMs across the United States.

The firm specializes in low- to mid-volume production, offering through-hole and surface-mount PCB assembly, cable and wire harness fabrication, box build integration, and full electromechanical assembly. A collective workforce of more than 100 employees supports these services from a facility the company describes as state-of-the-art.

Pine's customer base spans mass transit, mining, electrical transmission, rail, and communications sectors, serving both multinational corporations and regional businesses. Each client is assigned a dedicated representative to handle commercial and technical inquiries, a model intended to streamline communication and accelerate project development.

Quality assurance is anchored by an ISO 9001:2015 certified system, with IPC-certified trainers on staff for IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards. An auditor noted the company's proprietary ERP software, which optimizes cycle counting for high-usage or problematic parts, as an innovative feature for a company of its size.
